notes.title: Official Game Release!
notes.notes:
We just wanted to say after a long, long battle, we have finally released the game!  It is now available to be downloaded from the storefront.  Parts of the game are very difficult, but you'll get through it!  Let us know if you need any help.  Also, try find all the hidden VHS Tapes.  The title screen shows what percent of them you have found.  Can you find them all?  Good luck!

Also, we apologize about the start up glitch that previously occurred.  But... we did fix it, and now it should work perfectly fine!  :-)
